findings.text: When removing multiple matching calls from ExpectedCalls in the loop, removing an element at index i shifts subsequent elements down, but the loop increments i anyway, causing the next element to be skipped. With two identical expected calls, only the first gets removed and the second is never processed.

0.reason: The finding describes the same range-and-append removal bug in Unset, where the loop index is not adjusted after deletion, causing skipped elements and possible panic.
